title: Prefect Flow Flow Run Duration p95
app: Prefect worker/agent logs via UF; Prefect REST API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=prefect:api state_type="COMPLETED"
| eval dur_s=round(total_run_time/1,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by flow_name
| where p95_s>600
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes the 95th-percentile flow run duration for each flow in Prefect and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking Prefect flows by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest Prefect timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest flows with their owners.
visualization: Table of flow by p95 flow run duration, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in Prefect so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
